Card Q&A.a: Yes, you must add as many cards to your hand and place under your Tamers as possible.
Card Q&A.q: If cards that are targets of this effect are revealed from the deck, do I have to add as many cards to my hand and place under my Tamers as possible?

Card Q&A.a: No, you can't. If you only reveal 1 of the applicable cards, you add it to your hand.
Card Q&A.q: If the cards I reveal for this card's [On Deletion] effect include only 1 card with [Knightmon] in its text or the [Twilight] trait, can I place that card under my Tamer?

Effect: [On Deletion] Reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Among them, add 1 card with [Knightmon] in its text or the [Twilight] trait to the hand and place 1 such card under your Tamers. Return the rest to the bottom of the deck.
Inherited Effect: ＜Reboot＞ (This Digimon also unsuspends in your opponent's unsuspend phase.)
